title: Build a UIKit app with the new design
description: Update your UIKit app to take full advantage of the new design system. We’ll dive into key changes to tab views, split views, bars, presentations, search, and controls, and show you how to use Liquid Glass in your custom UI. To get the most out of this video, we recommend first watching “Get to know the new design system” for general design guidance.

codeSnippets.title: UIBarButtonItem tint color and style
Toolbar with evenly distributed items in a single background
codeSnippets.code:
// Toolbar with evenly distributed items, grouped in a single background.

let flexibleSpace = UIBarButtonItem.flexibleSpace()
flexibleSpace.hidesSharedBackground = false

toolbarItems = [
   .init(image: UIImage(systemName: "location")),
   flexibleSpace,
   .init(image: UIImage(systemName: "number")),
   flexibleSpace,
   .init(image: UIImage(systemName: "camera")),
   flexibleSpace,
   .init(image: UIImage(systemName: "trash")),
]
